title: Hanging the Green Shutters  (挂上绿色百叶窗)

segments.t: 周二阳光明媚的庭院里，凯勒布和格雷厄姆将晾干的菩提绿百叶窗抬起，挂回上过油的铁铰链上，而汉娜则站在石头上检查它们是否对齐。先完整听一遍吧。
Lift the left side half a centimeter, Caleb, now drop it onto the pin!
Solid! Swing it open against the stone wall and hook the iron catch.
Stand back by the courtyard tree, Hannah. How does the color look in daylight?
Like the room belonged to the tree all along! Green shutters, white arches, warm stone!
Now let us carry twelve folded chairs inside and wipe down the four cellar tables.
I measured the floor plan: four tables inside Room Nine, four outside under the lanterns.
And if it drizzles on Wednesday, twelve guests can still sit warm and dry behind the glass!
Look who is peering down from the upstairs landing: Arthur is beaming!
No green paint on his glasses today either!
All heavy work is finished twenty hours early, Hannah.
Now I only need to write clean cafe signs and help Tessa in the kitchen!
Do not celebrate yet: check the kitchen first. Tessa has six trays of lemons out.
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段充满成就感的对话。
Lift the left side half a centimeter, Caleb, now drop it onto the pin!
「把左边抬高半厘米，凯勒布，现在把它降到销子上！」 注意不定冠词 a 在表示度量分数的短语中的位置
half a centimeter
永远是 half a 而不是 a half，这是习惯用法。
Solid! Swing it open against the stone wall and hook the iron catch.
「稳了！把它朝石墙方向彻底推开，然后挂上铁搭扣。」 英语很喜欢用动词加上一个形容词，把动作及其结果浓缩在一起：
Swing it open
生动地描绘了百叶窗在铰链上划过一道弧线直到完全敞开的状态。
Stand back by the courtyard tree, Hannah. How does the color look in daylight?
「退到庭院那棵树边上，汉娜。在自然光下这颜色看起来怎么样？」 这里有两个实用的表达：stand back 让人向后退几步以便纵观全局，而
in daylight
不用加定冠词，用来强调用自然光和室内照明的对比。
Like the room belonged to the tree all along! Green shutters, white arches, warm stone!
「就好像这个房间从一开始就是属于这棵树的！绿色的百叶窗，白色的拱门，温暖的石头！」 放在句尾的这个口语表达
belonged to the tree all along
带着一种“一直如此”、“自始至终”的笃定感，仿佛生来就是这样搭配的。
Now let us carry twelve folded chairs inside and wipe down the four cellar tables.
「现在让我们把十二把折叠椅搬进去，再把四张地窖桌子擦干净。」 在表示擦洗的动词之后加上 down，强调全面彻底地清洁表面，
wipe down
指用湿布把整张桌子或吧台从头到尾擦干净。
I measured the floor plan: four tables inside Room Nine, four outside under the lanterns.
「我量过平面图了：四张桌子放在九号房间里，四张放在外面灯笼底下。」 对于像凯勒布这样的建筑师来说，从正上方俯视房间布局的图纸就叫做
the floor plan
也就是我们常说的平面图。
And if it drizzles on Wednesday, twelve guests can still sit warm and dry behind the glass!
「就算周三下毛毛雨，十二位客人依然可以温暖干燥地坐在玻璃后面！」 用来形容像雾气一样细密的蒙蒙细雨，英语有个专门的气象动词
if it drizzles
而后面的 sit warm and dry 则是把形容词直接跟在动词 sit 后面，表现一种安稳的状态。
Look who is peering down from the upstairs landing: Arthur is beaming!
「看看是谁正从楼上的平台上往下看：阿瑟笑得合不拢嘴了！」 两个极具画面感的动词：peer down 描绘了一个人从高处探出身子往下看的动作，而
Arthur is beaming
则捕捉到了阿瑟脸上那种由内而外散发出的灿烂笑容。
No green paint on his glasses today either!
「今天他的眼镜上也没有弄到绿油漆！」 在一个以 No 开头的否定句中，英语表达“也不”不是用 too 而是用
today either
通常放在整句话的最后。
All heavy work is finished twenty hours early, Hannah.
「所有重活都提前二十个小时干完了，汉娜。」 不要加任何介词：表示提前多久的时间段可以直接放在副词前面：
twenty hours early
这种结构如果换成 late 也完全适用，表示迟到了多久。
Now I only need to write clean cafe signs and help Tessa in the kitchen!
「现在我只需要写几块干净的咖啡馆招牌，再到厨房帮帮泰莎！」 在我们要表达“只需要做某事”的时候，英语直接把 only 放在动词前面：
I only need to write
而且后面 help 前面省略了第二个 to，非常利落。
Do not celebrate yet: check the kitchen first. Tessa has six trays of lemons out.
「先别急着庆祝：先去检查一下厨房。泰莎端出了六大盘柠檬。」 放在句子的最后，表示方位的介词词组
six trays of lemons out
说明柠檬已经端出来摆在台面上了。现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
Lift the left side half a centimeter, Caleb, now drop it onto the pin!
Solid! Swing it open against the stone wall and hook the iron catch.
Stand back by the courtyard tree, Hannah. How does the color look in daylight?
Like the room belonged to the tree all along! Green shutters, white arches, warm stone!
Now let us carry twelve folded chairs inside and wipe down the four cellar tables.
I measured the floor plan: four tables inside Room Nine, four outside under the lanterns.
And if it drizzles on Wednesday, twelve guests can still sit warm and dry behind the glass!
Look who is peering down from the upstairs landing: Arthur is beaming!
No green paint on his glasses today either!
All heavy work is finished twenty hours early, Hannah.
Now I only need to write clean cafe signs and help Tessa in the kitchen!
Do not celebrate yet: check the kitchen first. Tessa has six trays of lemons out.
清新的绿色百叶窗环绕着阳光照耀的玻璃，桌椅已摆放整齐，接下来的周二傍晚，厨房的备料工作即将拉开帷幕。我们下个场景见。
See you later!
